description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Ekko's''' basic attacks deal '''bonus''' magic damage equal to 3% (+ 3% per 100 AP) of the target's '''missing''' health against enemies below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 30% of their '''maximum''' health. The damage has a minimum threshold of 15 and is capped at 150 against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Passive: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 3% per 100 AP) of the target's missing health against enemies below  30% of their maximum health. The damage has a minimum threshold of 15 and is capped at 150 against minions and monsters.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ekko''' creates an afterimage of himself that, after 2 seconds, bats a device to the target location and grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 2.5 seconds. After travelling over 1.25 seconds, the device expands into a chronosphere that lasts for 1.5 seconds and which [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] enemies within by 40%.
description2.text: Active: Ekko creates an afterimage of himself that, after 2 seconds, bats a device to the target location and grants sight of the area for 2.5 seconds. After travelling over 1.25 seconds, the device expands into a chronosphere that lasts for 1.5 seconds and which slows enemies within by 40%.

description3.raw: If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 2 seconds and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] enemies within for 2.25 seconds.
description3.text: If Ekko enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a shield for 2 seconds and stun enemies within for 2.25 seconds.

description4.raw: ''Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.''
description4.text: Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.

leveling3.raw:

notes.raw: * The passive will proc with the attack that triggers the final stack of [[File:Ekko Z-Drive Resonance.png|20xpx|border|link=Ekko#Z-Drive Resonance|An icon for Ekko's ability Z-Drive Resonance]] [[Ekko#Z-Drive Resonance|Resonance]] if it reduces a target's health below the 30% threshold. * '''Ekko''' can detonate the expansion even while [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] (i.e. [[File:Ekko Chronobreak.png|20xpx|border|link=Ekko#Chronobreak|An icon for Ekko's ability Chronobreak]] [[Ekko#Chronobreak|Chronobreak's]] dash), but not if he is [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrecting]]. * ''Parallel Convergence'' will continue to [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] enemies even if its expansion is detonated.
notes.text:
The passive will proc with the attack that triggers the final stack of Resonance if it reduces a target's health below the 30% threshold.
Ekko can detonate the expansion even while untargetable (i.e. Chronobreak's dash), but not if he is resurrecting.
Parallel Convergence will continue to slow enemies even if its expansion is detonated.
